requirement:
During coverage-data preparation, on a terminal enabled under
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.processes.progress.terminal`, Habeas MUST
display updating activity and identify the current preparation stage.
rationale:
The requirement has two obligations. During coverage-data preparation on a terminal that is enabled under `requirements.test-coverage.processes.progress.terminal`, Habeas MUST (1) display updating activity and (2) identify the current preparation stage. The enabled-terminal condition itself belongs to the cited terminal requirement, so I treated it as context.

**Stage identification**
- Implementation: `Progress::preparation` in `src/execution_coverage/progress.rs` starts with "Preparing coverage: recording inputs". `fn[run]` in `src/execution_coverage/runner.rs` then calls `progress.stage("Preparing coverage: capturing maps")`. These are the only two preparation stages I found.
- Unit test: `src/execution_coverage/progress.rs#mod[tests]/fn[stage_and_conversion_counts_are_visible_then_cleared]` creates a preparation `Progress` on a recording terminal. It asserts the initial label is drawn, calls `stage(...)`, and asserts the new label is drawn. It also asserts the display is cleared on drop.
- End-to-end test: `tests/execution_coverage.rs#fn[coverage_progress_on_a_pty_preserves_reports_and_plain_output_policy]` runs the real binary on a PTY with `TERM=xterm`. It asserts stderr contains both "Preparing coverage: recording inputs" and "Preparing coverage: capturing maps". Together these cover both stages the code uses.

**Updating activity**
- `src/execution_coverage/progress.rs#mod[tests]/fn[preparation_activity_keeps_updating_without_a_stage_change]` creates a preparation display and makes no stage change. It polls the recorded frames until at least two distinct frames containing "Recording inputs" appear, each with an elapsed-time marker. That is a real assertion that the display keeps updating on its own.
- The PTY test also asserts that in-place terminal control sequences and `[00:` timers appear.

**Other points**
- Clearing at stage end, non-terminal and `TERM=dumb` suppression, and `NO_COLOR` are obligations of `requirements.test-coverage.processes.progress.terminal`. They are not assessed here.
- All three tests carry `{test}` references to the subject, so there is no marking gap.

I found no unacknowledged gap.

text: During coverage-data preparation, on a terminal enabled under
display updating activity and identify the current preparation stage.
Habeas coverage progress MUST be displayed when stderr is an interactive
terminal and `TERM` is not `dumb`. `NO_COLOR` MUST disable color without
disabling progress. When stderr is redirected or `TERM=dumb`, Habeas coverage
progress MUST NOT emit animation or terminal control sequences.
Temporary progress displays MUST be cleared when their stage ends, including
empty work and early collection failures. Final diagnostics and the coverage
artifact location MUST remain readable. Progress reporting MUST NOT change
coverage results, retained profiles, or command exit status.
